A transaction proposed, validated and committed has a Transactions row whose hashes are the ones its own occurrences published, and no committed row has a null Optional field.
A transaction adds an alias to a node created earlier without one, validates against the head and commits as the next revision.
A proposal's one stored object is Canonical, has the proposal record's length and address, and its one preparation is the first attempt.
Evidence added under an id canonical state already holds is rejected with one issue, identity-already-exists, raised by Structural.
A widening of an edge type the schema does not declare is rejected with one issue, unknown-edge-type, raised by OntologyConstraint.
A widening that names exactly the ends an edge type already has is rejected with one issue, schema-change-without-effect, raised by OntologyConstraint.
A widening that adds a node type the schema does not declare is rejected with one issue, unknown-endpoint-type, raised by OntologyConstraint.
An alias added to a node when another node of its type already holds it is rejected with one issue, alias-already-exists, raised by Structural.
An alias added to a node no revision holds is rejected with one issue, unresolved-node, raised by Reference.
An assertion citing evidence that neither a revision nor its own transaction holds is rejected with one issue, unresolved-evidence, raised by Reference.
Evidence that neither a revision nor its own transaction holds, attached to a held assertion, is rejected with one issue, unresolved-evidence, raised by Reference.
Evidence attached to an assertion an earlier commit retracted is rejected with one issue, assertion-not-active, raised by Structural.
Evidence attached to an assertion an earlier commit superseded is rejected with one issue, assertion-not-active, raised by Structural.
Evidence attached to an assertion no revision holds is rejected with one issue, unresolved-assertion, raised by Reference.
A schema-only transaction widens an edge type's target types to another declared node type and commits, and the next transaction commits edges to that type.
A widening whose target types leave out a type the edge type already has is rejected with one issue, edge-endpoint-removed, raised by OntologyConstraint.
Evidence whose payload bytes do not hash to its content_hash is rejected with one issue, evidence-payload-mismatch, raised by Provenance.
A committed assertion is explained through its own commit's five-link chain, before and after a later commit.
A transaction that adds evidence and an assertion citing it validates and commits, and the evidence is then retained with its payload held at its content hash.
A transaction that adds evidence and attaches it to an assertion an earlier revision holds validates and commits, and the evidence is then retained with its payload held at its content hash.
Evidence attached a second time is rejected by Structural as evidence-already-attached.
Evidence attached to an assertion that already cites it is rejected with one issue, evidence-already-attached, raised by Structural.
One alias given to two nodes of a type in one transaction is rejected with one issue, duplicate-alias, raised by Structural.
Two transactions rejected against revisions 0 and 1 answer Rejections with each of their issues under the revision each was validated against, and the transaction committed beside them has no row.
A snapshot at revision 0, read while revision 1 is the newest, reports revision 0 and revision 0's knowledge root.
A snapshot that names no revision reports the newest revision, 1, and that revision's knowledge root.
